consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Kaithangu connects you with workers from Labour Cooperative Societies. Please read these points.
consent.point_phone: We use your mobile number to sign you in and to send you updates about your jobs.
consent.point_sharing: When you book a job, the worker and their society see your name, address and job details.
consent.point_payment: The price shows the worker's full wage, a welfare contribution for the worker, and a platform fee.
consent.point_rights: You can ask your society to correct or delete your details.
